Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a custom trifunctional lipid probe for photo-crosslinking and click-chemistry based enrichment of PIP3-binding proteins. While the PRIDE metadata lists 'Chemical cross-linking', the methodology is essentially an affinity purification (AP-MS) using a synthetic probe. Quantification is performed via spectral counting (LFQ). Acquisition is DDA based on the description of precursor isolation and HCD triggering.
